entries.subject: Size: JPL Small-Body Database diameter
entries.finding: 60558 Echeclus (2000 EC98) is drawn as a sphere at the 59 km diameter the JPL Small-Body Database lists, with JPL's stated reference urn:nasa:pds:neowise_diameters_albedos::2.0[centaurs]. No shape model is published, so the sphere is illustrative.
